title: Samsung Bluetooth very unstable
symptom: Samsung S9 with Libre and miaomiao will not stay connected and eventually cannot connect at all. Other Samsung phones (S9+, A5 2017, S6 edge) also experience unstable Bluetooth connections, with connections dropping after some time and failing to reconnect.
cause: The thread identifies a possible issue with Android 8.0 (Oreo) on Samsung devices causing Bluetooth problems, possibly related to a June 5 security patch. A user also found that the 'Allow blucon unbonding' option, which defaults to enabled, may cause pairing failures due to a bug in the code.
fix: Several workarounds are suggested: clearing the Bluetooth cache on the phone, disabling the 'Allow blucon unbonding' option (which resolved issues for one user), and using Glimp to maintain the Bluetooth connection. A Samsung security patch (G950FXXU2CRF1) was reported to fix issues on S8.
evidence_quote: I had horrible problems with it lately (on and off for months, after working great for a while), and then found a new option had been added: "Allow blucon unbonding", which defaults to enabled.  Turning this off seems to fix everything.
